NVT Name: Joomla! Core LDAP Information Disclosure Vulnerability (Nov 2017)
Summary: Joomla is prone to an information disclosure vulnerability.
Impact:
Successfully exploiting this issue allow
  remote attackers to disclose username and password.
Solution: Upgrade to Joomla version 3.8.2 or later.
Vulnerability Insight:
The flaw exists due to an inadequate
  escaping in the LDAP authentication plugin.
Vulnerability Detection Method:
Checks if a vulnerable version is present on the target host.
